convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for 3LineBreak custom indicator and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trading operations (open/close positions with money management). Custom indicator not available as built-in.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe period in seconds for signal time calculation
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime, DnSignalTime for position open timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA processes signals

other_exits: Trend continuation close: if BuyPosOpen&&BuyPosClose&&TrendValue[1]==1 then close buy on same-trend bar; if SellPosOpen&&SellPosClose&&TrendValue[1]==0 then close sell on same-trend bar - this closes positions at end of trend continuation when both open and close flags are enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing: LOT=fixed lots (MM=0.1 lots), FREEMARGIN=MM fraction of free margin, BALANCE=MM fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=MM fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=MM fraction of balance minus loss. Delegated to TradeAlgorithms.mqh library.

custom_logic_notes: Signal is read from 3LineBreak indicator buffer index 2 (trend state buffer). TrendValue[0] is at SignalBar (default=1, previous bar) and TrendValue[1] is at SignalBar+1. Entry signal: TrendValue shifts from 0 to 1 (buy) or 1 to 0 (sell). When SignalBar=0, signals are checked every tick instead of only on new bars. The close logic has two paths: (1) reverse-signal close when trend flips, and (2) same-trend continuation close when both BuyPosOpen/BuyPosClose or SellPosOpen/SellPosClose are enabled AND TrendValue[1] confirms current trend direction - this latter path appears to close at each new bar within a trend if both open and close flags are true, which is unusual. Position open/close functions and money management are entirely delegated to TradeAlgorithms.mqh library. GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit also from the library.
python_conversion_notes: The 3LineBreak custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python (three-line break chart logic is well-documented). The indicator outputs a trend state buffer (0 or 1) at buffer index 2. TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles all order execution and money management - the full logic for BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, and the MarginMode-based sizing must be reimplemented or the .mqh source obtained. The CIsNewBar class for new bar detection also comes from the library. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - value of 1000/2000 points = 100/200 pips on 5-digit brokers; no digit adjustment code exists in the EA itself so the library or indicator may handle it. SignalBar=1 means signals are calculated on the last closed bar, making this a low-frequency bar-based strategy suitable for per-bar backtesting on M1 or H1 data resampled to H12.
